result.title: Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning
result.comment: main 11 pages, total 55 pages, main 2 figures, total 4 figures, 1 algorithm table in appendix
result.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. (ii) SFT on correct reasoning paths can lead to catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates along the training paths, which overwrite the information previously acquired. (iii) Diversity in pre-training is crucial for enabling a post-trained model to reach a correct output when a rollout starts from an intermediate state. Our results, supported by theoretical analysis, show that reliable continual reasoning depends on how post-training updates interact with the reasoning structure established during pre-training.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文将 LLM 推理建模为有向无环图上的搜索，从理论上比较持续学习中 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）与监督微调（SFT）的更新动态，指出带正确提示的 OPSD 通过稀疏更新避免遗忘，而 SFT 的稠密更新会导致灾难性遗忘，并讨论预训练多样性对从中间状态恢复的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本理论工作，但其关于「提示/中间状态启动 rollout」的更新稀疏性与中间状态可恢复性分析，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督、贡献分配与推理状态训练提供线索，值得核查其与 latent 轨迹监督的对应关系。
